title: Argument encoding
statement:
Given a natural number $S$ and an optional natural-number argument $a$, encode it as an optional element of $	ext{Fin}(S)$: an absent argument, or a present $a 
ot< S$, is encoded as absent; a present $a<S$ is encoded by its corresponding element of $	ext{Fin}(S)$.
